Select all the contractions in the text.

atoms.a: I’m starting a brand-new school today. It’s in a new area, so I don’t know anyone and that’s a bit nerve-racking for me. Luckily, I’ve already visited the school once, and I’ve met one of my classmates. He’s my new next-door neighbour, and I think we’ll get on really well. I do wish I could’ve stayed at my old school, but I shouldn’t be so negative and give this school a chance. It’s a great opportunity to meet new friends and experience a new place.
